page.notes: Three columns of an alphabetical index, with leaf-and-side references (e.g. 403.b.1). Printed entries are transcribed as set; the rows marked "a.1" etc. are page references. Some letters in the scan are damaged or faint, notably in the "Nouatianorum", "Obuelatio" and "Pastorum" entries; "Paulus quomodo de se sentiat" line and the final "Paulus" catchword are at the foot of column three.
